name: Sway
summary:
Lizzy's friends have been captured! If she wants to rescue them, she'll have to make her way through more than 20 tricky obstacle courses suspended high in the sky. Moving platforms and dangerous spikes are a major hazard, but the biggest enemy is gravity! Swing and sway to build momentum and move from hand to hand to make your way across each course. Take big leaps to reach the goal even faster.

It's not just about reaching the end of each challenging course. You'll also need to hunt down keys to rescue your friends. Once you've freed a buddy, they'll be ready to join Lizzy's adventure. Each course offers a huge number of routes to explore if you're brave enough to venture off the beaten path. Gather tons of stars and find the fastest way to the goal to earn medals and show you've mastered the art of swaying. Make sure you hold on tight — it's a long way down!
